site.name: booking
site.summary: booking-clone Clone of the Booking.com hotel booking funnel (home → city list → area filters → detail → room → booking → confirmation), plus other business-line and supporting pages. Pages | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Home: search bar (destination / check-in & out dates / guests), recommended destinations, recent searches, Genius membership prompt, business-line entries in the footer | | `tokyo.html` | Tokyo hotel list: left filter panel (price, stars, rating, amenities, area), right-hand hotel cards (price, rating, review count, distance, free-cancellation tag), sort bar, map entry | | `shinjuku.html` | Shinjuku-area hotel list, same structure as above, pre-filtered to Shinjuku |

run_plan.goal: Autonomously explore and critique the UX of the full booking system, prioritizing the primary checkout/booking flow plus adjacent pages, states, and recovery paths.
run_plan.summary: The exploration will proceed by first validating the primary hotel booking funnel from the homepage through search, detail, room selection, reservation, and confirmation. Next, it will test adjacent business lines (flights, cars, taxis, attractions) and supporting flows (account management, help, deals). Finally, it will assess error states, filter interactions, and mobile responsiveness across critical paths.
assumptions: The site is a static clone where form submissions redirect to subsequent HTML pages rather than performing backend validation.
Filtering on list pages (tokyo.html, shinjuku.html) updates the UI visually but may not dynamically fetch new data.
Authentication flows (signin, register) are mocked and will not actually create accounts or log in.
Cross-selling links on the confirmation page lead to the respective business line pages.
risk_hotspots: reservation.html: Long form with multiple inputs, dropdowns, and radio buttons; high risk of layout issues on mobile and missing labels.
tokyo.html & shinjuku.html: Dense filter panels with numerous checkboxes; high risk of tap target overlap and small tap target sizes on mobile.
index.html: Search widget with date and guest selectors; potential for poor responsiveness and overlapping elements on smaller screens.
signin.html & register.html: Social login buttons (G, f, Apple) are often too small or closely spaced, violating mobile tap target guidelines.

phases.title: Primary Booking Funnel
phases.objective: Validate the core hotel booking flow from search to confirmation, ensuring all steps are intuitive and correctly linked.
key_checks: Execute search from homepage to Tokyo list
Navigate from list to hotel detail page
Select room and proceed to room selection
Complete reservation form and submit
Verify confirmation page displays correct booking summary and cross-sell links
exit_criteria: Successfully traversed from index.html to confirmation.html
Validated presence and visibility of key elements at each step
Noted any UX friction in the checkout flow

phases.title: Search & Filter Interactions
phases.objective: Test the filtering and sorting capabilities on the hotel list pages to ensure they are functional and usable.
key_checks: Apply various filters (price, stars, review score, neighborhood)
Interact with sort options
Check for filter conflicts or empty state messaging ('No properties match your filters')
Validate search bar modifications on list pages
exit_criteria: Interacted with at least 5 different filter categories
Assessed mobile layout of the filter panel

phases.title: Adjacent Business Lines
phases.objective: Explore the UX of alternative booking flows (flights, cars, taxis, attractions) to ensure consistency and completeness.
key_checks: Perform search interactions on each business line page
Verify form inputs and selectors are usable
Check for layout consistency with the main hotel flow
Validate 'Book' or 'View deal' interactions
exit_criteria: Visited all 4 adjacent business line pages
Attempted a search or booking action on each
Noted any broken links or missing elements

phases.title: Support & Account Flows
phases.objective: Validate the usability of account management, help, and trip management pages.
key_checks: Attempt to sign in and register (validate form fields and social login buttons)
Navigate My Trips tabs (Upcoming, Completed, Cancelled)
Interact with Help Center search and FAQ links
Check for clear feedback on form validation
exit_criteria: Navigated all tabs in My Trips
Performed a search in the Help Center

phases.title: Mobile & Edge Case Validation
phases.objective: Re-test critical paths and high-risk areas on a mobile viewport to identify responsive design issues and tap target violations.
key_checks: Verify search widget layout and usability on mobile
Check filter panel accessibility and tap target sizes on mobile list pages
Validate reservation form layout and input usability on small screens
Ensure social login buttons meet minimum tap target sizes
exit_criteria: Completed primary booking funnel on mobile viewport

coverage_targets.features: exercise search, filtering, sorting, form submissions, and tab navigations across all key pages
coverage_targets.mobile: repeat primary booking flow, filter interaction, and auth flows on mobile viewport

notes: Focus heavily on the reservation form and filter panels as they have the most complex interactions and highest risk of UX issues.
Prescan indicates widespread 'small_tap_target' warnings; specifically verify these on mobile viewport.
Check for 'missing_input_label' warnings on airport-taxis, car-rentals, shinjuku, and tokyo pages during interaction.

Each room is spacious and elegantly designed with floor-to-ceiling windows, deep soaking tubs, and original artwork. The hotel is located in the Nishi-Shinjuku business district, a 12-minute walk from Shinjuku Station. Guests can enjoy the Girandole restaurant for all-day dining, the Peak Bar for cocktails with a view, and the Kozue restaurant for authentic Japanese cuisine. The spa offers a range of treatments in a serene setting on the 45th floor. observation.title: Shinjuku Granbell Hotel - Booking.com
observation.visible_text: Booking.com Stays Flights Car rentals Attractions Airport taxis JPY List your property Sign in Home > Japan > Tokyo > Shinjuku > Shinjuku Granbell Hotel ★★★ Shinjuku Granbell Hotel 📍 2-14-5 Kabukicho, Shinjuku, Tokyo, 160-0021, Japan · Very Good location — rated 8.4/10 🏙 🛌 🍵 🏊 🌄 About Shinjuku Granbell Hotel Located in the heart of Shinjuku, the Granbell Hotel offers modern accommodations just a 5-minute walk from Shinjuku-Sanchome Station. The hotel features stylish rooms with contemporary Japanese design, a rooftop bar with panoramic city views, and easy access to Tokyo's vibrant nightlife and shopping districts. Each room is thoughtfully designed with comfortable bedding, free WiFi, and modern amenities. The hotel is surrounded by restaurants, convenience stores, and is within walking distance of Kabukicho entertainment district and Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden. Guests can enjoy the on-site restaurant serving Japanese and international cuisine, relax at the rooftop terrace, and explore the many attractions nearby including Meiji Shrine and Takeshita Street in Harajuku. observation.title: Park Hyatt Tokyo - Guest Reviews - Booking.com
observation.visible_text: Booking.com Stays Flights Car rentals Attractions JPY Sign in Home > Tokyo > Park Hyatt Tokyo > Guest reviews Guest reviews Park Hyatt Tokyo 9.4 Exceptional 3,847 reviews Staff 9.6 Facilities 9.4 Cleanliness 9.6 Comfort 9.5 Value for money 8.8 Location 9.6 Free WiFi 9.2 Breakfast 9.3 All reviews (3,847) Most relevant Most recent Highest score Lowest score All Couples (1,234) Families (876) Solo travellers (543) Business (1,194) TK Takeshi Japan · Couple · Deluxe King Room · 3 nights 10 Absolutely perfect in every way 👍 Liked The views from the 47th floor were breathtaking. Staff remembered our names from the first interaction. The New York Grill breakfast is worth every yen. Pool area is serene and never crowded. 👎 Disliked Nothing to complain about. Perhaps the walk from Shinjuku station is a bit long in summer heat, but the hotel shuttle solves that. Reviewed: June 2025 SM Sarah M. United States · Solo traveller · Park King Room · 5 nights 9.6 Lost in Translation vibes, but better 👍 Liked The atmosphere is exactly what you'd hope for. The library lounge is perfect for quiet afternoons. Girandole breakfast buffet has incredible variety. The bed is the most comfortable I've ever slept in. 👎 Disliked Price is steep, but you get what you pay for. The gym can get busy in the early morning. Reviewed: May 2025 LW Li Wei China · Family · Deluxe Twin Room · 4 nights 9.2 Excellent for families with older children 👍 Liked Spacious rooms, impeccable service. observation.title: Park Hyatt Tokyo - Booking.com
observation.visible_text: Booking.com Stays Flights Car rentals Attractions Airport taxis JPY List your property Sign in Home > Japan > Tokyo > Shinjuku > Park Hyatt Tokyo ← Back to results ★★★★★ Park Hyatt Tokyo 📍 3-7-1-2 Nishi Shinjuku, Shinjuku, Tokyo, 163-1055, Japan · Excellent location — rated 9.6/10 🏯 🛌 🍵 🏊 🌄 About Park Hyatt Tokyo Occupying the top 14 floors of the 52-story Shinjuku Park Tower, Park Hyatt Tokyo offers panoramic views of the city skyline and Mount Fuji. The hotel features the renowned New York Grill restaurant, a 20-meter indoor swimming pool, and the Club on the Park fitness center with a stunning view of the city. Each room is spacious and elegantly designed with floor-to-ceiling windows, deep soaking tubs, and original artwork. The hotel is located in the Nishi-Shinjuku business district, a 12-minute walk from Shinjuku Station. Guests can enjoy the Girandole restaurant for all-day dining, the Peak Bar for cocktails with a view, and the Kozue restaurant for authentic Japanese cuisine. The spa offers a range of treatments in a serene setting on the 45th floor. observation.title: Park Hyatt Tokyo - Booking.com
observation.visible_text: Booking.com Stays Flights Car rentals Attractions Airport taxis JPY List your property Sign in Home > Japan > Tokyo > Shinjuku > Park Hyatt Tokyo ← Back to results ★★★★★ Park Hyatt Tokyo 📍 3-7-1-2 Nishi Shinjuku, Shinjuku, Tokyo, 163-1055, Japan · Excellent location — rated 9.6/10 🏯 🛌 🍵 🏊 🌄 About Park Hyatt Tokyo Occupying the top 14 floors of the 52-story Shinjuku Park Tower, Park Hyatt Tokyo offers panoramic views of the city skyline and Mount Fuji. The hotel features the renowned New York Grill restaurant, a 20-meter indoor swimming pool, and the Club on the Park fitness center with a stunning view of the city. Each room is spacious and elegantly designed with floor-to-ceiling windows, deep soaking tubs, and original artwork. The hotel is located in the Nishi-Shinjuku business district, a 12-minute walk from Shinjuku Station. Guests can enjoy the Girandole restaurant for all-day dining, the Peak Bar for cocktails with a view, and the Kozue restaurant for authentic Japanese cuisine. The spa offers a range of treatments in a serene setting on the 45th floor.
